cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

mechanism: A treats its pupil attempt to assign blame as poor agenda management, moving each proposed discussion into a prerequisite process before answering.
confusable: Not distributing blame across actors: A excludes the personal question from the current meeting and postpones each workaround.
comparison: Repair venue safety versus replacement dinner calendar and cancellation reviews.
